status: settings fixed before extension outcomes; not an external preregistration

noise.type: additive zero-mean Gaussian noise, normalized to exact full-clip SNR, no clipping
noise.pairing: same per-clip noise realization scaled across SNR conditions
noise.model: released checkpoint, eager attention, eval, CPU, original full-clip normalization
noise.score: original frozen development coefficients and threshold; no refitting
noise.primary: equal-container mean assumed-reference MAE and paired change from recomputed clean

endpoint.primary: median wavelength within 0.2 s of final prediction timestamp
endpoint.reference: original H*(1-t/duration), assumption-derived; all prediction frames
endpoint.selection: evaluate every fixed recording; no label-tuned per-clip window

visual.sampling_frame: all 8 existing seen-test paired videos, before model comparison
visual.alignment: nearest decoded video frame to audio start PTS + fraction * analysis-WAV duration; save actual PTS
visual.annotation: AI-assisted visual coordinates and explicit uncertainty intervals, without displaying model predictions; human review remains separate
visual.include: rim, internal base and water-surface central region all identifiable; fixed geometry landmarks and water-surface bounds recorded
visual.reject: base out of frame, occlusion, bubbles, reflections, unresolvable waterline, or uncertain geometry
visual.primary: image-relative visible filling fraction and trend; geometric/projection proxy, not exact physical height
visual.metric_conversion: no primary centimetre accuracy claim; image projection and inner-height uncertainty remain
visual.report: all 72 planned frames accounted for, including excluded and ambiguous frames; no selection by model error
visual.independence: independent visual modality, not independent human measurement or new dataset

statistics.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of containers, averaging noise seeds within each container first
statistics.interval: percentile 95%; exploratory small-sample uncertainty, no multiple-comparison claim
prohibited_claims: new unseen-container validation from seen-test video
noise denoising benefit without neural rerun
